description: Project catalogue used by the recommendation engine. Projects are matched to a candidate by the skills they actually teach, so a project is only recommended when it closes a real, prioritised gap. resume_bullet_template is a fill-in-the-blank scaffold - it is never presented as an achievement the candidate already has.

projects.title: Deploy an End-to-End Machine Learning Model on AWS
projects.description: Train a model on a real dataset, wrap it in a REST API, containerise it, deploy it to AWS and add basic monitoring so you can talk about the whole lifecycle, not just the notebook.
objectives: Train and evaluate a model with a held-out test set
Serve predictions through a REST API
Containerise the service with Docker
Deploy to AWS (SageMaker endpoint or ECS/Lambda)
Log requests and track model performance after deployment
deliverables: Public repository with README and architecture diagram
Live or recorded demo of the deployed endpoint
Short write-up of latency and cost per prediction
projects.resume_bullet_template: Deployed a <model type> model as a containerised REST service on AWS <service>, serving predictions at <latency> ms p95 on <dataset/traffic description>.
projects.verification: Keep the endpoint reachable or record a demo video - interviewers ask to see it.

projects.title: Reproducible MLOps Pipeline with Experiment Tracking
projects.description: Build a training pipeline where every run is versioned, tracked and reproducible, with automated retraining triggered by new data.
objectives: Version datasets, code and model artefacts together
Track experiments with metrics and parameters
Automate retraining and evaluation in CI
Register the best model and promote it through stages
Detect and alert on data or prediction drift
projects.resume_bullet_template: Built a reproducible training pipeline with experiment tracking and automated retraining, cutting the time to evaluate a new model idea from <before> to <after>.
projects.verification: Show the run history - reviewers look for evidence of many tracked iterations, not one.

projects.title: Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering Assistant
projects.description: Build a question answering system over a document corpus you care about, with chunking, embeddings, a vector store and a measured evaluation set.
objectives: Chunk and embed a document corpus
Implement retrieval with a vector store
Ground generated answers in retrieved passages with citations
Build an evaluation set and measure answer quality
Handle failure cases such as no relevant context
projects.resume_bullet_template: Built a retrieval-augmented QA system over <corpus>, achieving <metric> on a hand-built evaluation set of <n> questions.
projects.verification: The evaluation set is the differentiator - most candidates skip it, and interviewers notice.

projects.title: Fine-Tune a Small Language Model for a Domain Task
projects.description: Take an open-weights model and fine-tune it with LoRA on a focused task, comparing it honestly against a prompted baseline.
objectives: Prepare and clean a task-specific dataset
Fine-tune with parameter-efficient methods
Compare against a zero-shot and few-shot baseline
Measure quality, latency and cost
Document where the model still fails
projects.resume_bullet_template: Fine-tuned <base model> with LoRA for <task>, improving <metric> from <baseline> to <result> against a prompted baseline.
projects.verification: Publish the model card - honest failure analysis reads as senior.

projects.title: Recommendation and Ranking System with Offline Evaluation
projects.description: Build a recommender on a public interaction dataset, implement ranking metrics properly, and simulate an online experiment.
objectives: Build a baseline (popularity) and a learned ranker
Implement NDCG, recall@k and coverage correctly
Handle cold start explicitly
Design an A/B test you would run to validate the model
Discuss the offline / online metric gap
projects.resume_bullet_template: Built and evaluated a ranking model on <dataset>, improving NDCG@10 from <baseline> to <result> over a popularity baseline.
projects.verification: Show the baseline. A ranker with no baseline comparison is not evaluable.

projects.title: Real-Time Streaming Data Pipeline
projects.description: Ingest a live or simulated event stream through Kafka, process it, and land it in a warehouse with quality checks and dashboards.
objectives: Produce and consume events through a message broker
Handle late, duplicate and malformed events
Write processed data to a warehouse table
Add data quality assertions with alerting
Expose a dashboard on the live data
projects.resume_bullet_template: Built a streaming pipeline processing <volume> events/min through Kafka into <warehouse>, with automated data quality checks on <n> critical fields.
projects.verification: Exactly-once vs at-least-once reasoning is the interview question this project earns you.

projects.title: Analytics Warehouse with dbt and Dimensional Models
projects.description: Take messy raw data and build a properly modelled warehouse with tested, documented transformations.
objectives: Design fact and dimension tables for a real domain
Implement incremental models
Add schema and data tests to every model
Generate documentation and lineage
Optimise a slow query and record the improvement
deliverables: Generated docs site with lineage graph
projects.resume_bullet_template: Modelled <n> source tables into a tested dbt warehouse with <n> data tests, reducing a core report query from <before> to <after>.
projects.verification: Lineage graphs screenshot well and prove the modelling was real.

projects.title: Production-Grade REST API with Load Testing
projects.description: Build a backend service with authentication, caching, migrations and observability, then load test it and fix what breaks.
objectives: Design resource-oriented endpoints with proper status codes
Add authentication and rate limiting
Introduce caching and measure the hit rate
Write integration tests and run them in CI
Load test and document the bottleneck you removed
projects.resume_bullet_template: Built a REST service handling <rps> requests/sec at <latency> ms p95, improving throughput <n>x by introducing <specific change>.
projects.verification: Keep the load test output - the numbers are the point of this project.

projects.title: Kubernetes Deployment with Infrastructure as Code
projects.description: Provision cloud infrastructure with Terraform, deploy a multi-service application to Kubernetes, and automate the whole thing in CI/CD.
objectives: Define all infrastructure as code
Deploy services with health checks and autoscaling
Set up ingress and TLS
Automate build and deploy in a pipeline
Add metrics, dashboards and alerts
projects.resume_bullet_template: Provisioned <cloud> infrastructure with Terraform and deployed <n> services to Kubernetes with automated CI/CD and autoscaling from <min> to <max> replicas.
projects.verification: `terraform destroy` then `apply` cleanly - reproducibility is the skill being demonstrated.

projects.title: Text Classification System with Transformer Fine-Tuning
projects.description: Build a text classifier end to end: baseline, transformer model, error analysis and a served endpoint.
objectives: Establish a TF-IDF plus linear baseline
Fine-tune a transformer and compare fairly
Analyse errors by class and slice
Handle class imbalance explicitly
Serve the model behind an API
projects.resume_bullet_template: Fine-tuned a transformer for <task>, raising macro F1 from <baseline> to <result> over a TF-IDF baseline on <n> labelled examples.
projects.verification: The baseline comparison is what separates this from a tutorial.

projects.title: Computer Vision Detection Pipeline with Optimised Inference
projects.description: Train or adapt an object detection model, then make it fast enough to run in real time.
objectives: Prepare and augment an image dataset
Train or fine-tune a detection model
Measure mAP correctly
Optimise inference (quantisation, batching or TensorRT)
Report the speed/accuracy trade-off
deliverables: Repository with training and inference code
projects.resume_bullet_template: Optimised a detection model to <fps> FPS on <hardware> with <n>% mAP retained, a <n>x speedup over the unoptimised baseline.
projects.verification: Report the hardware. Speed claims without hardware context are not credible.

projects.title: GPU-Accelerated Compute Kernel with Benchmarks
projects.description: Implement a compute-heavy operation on CPU, then in CUDA, and benchmark the difference rigorously.
objectives: Write a correct CPU reference implementation
Port the hot path to CUDA
Profile memory access patterns
Benchmark across input sizes
Explain where the speedup comes from
projects.resume_bullet_template: Implemented <operation> in CUDA achieving a <n>x speedup over an optimised CPU baseline on <hardware>, verified across <n> input sizes.
projects.verification: Correctness tests against the CPU reference are mandatory or the speedup means nothing.

projects.title: Experimentation Analysis on a Real Dataset
projects.description: Design, analyse and write up an A/B test properly, including power analysis and the decision you would make.
objectives: Define a primary metric and guardrail metrics
Run a power analysis to size the test
Analyse results with the right statistical test
Check for common pitfalls (peeking, novelty, SRM)
Write the launch recommendation
projects.resume_bullet_template: Designed and analysed an experiment on <dataset>, sizing it via power analysis at <power> and recommending <decision> based on a <effect> lift.
projects.verification: The decision memo matters more than the notebook - it shows business judgement.

projects.title: Executive Analytics Dashboard with Defined Metrics
projects.description: Build a dashboard that a real stakeholder would use, with documented metric definitions and validated numbers.
objectives: Interview a real or hypothetical stakeholder for requirements
Define every metric precisely in writing
Build the dashboard with drill-down capability
Validate numbers against a second source
Write the insight summary, not just the charts
projects.resume_bullet_template: Built a <tool> dashboard covering <n> metrics for <audience>, replacing a manual report that previously took <time> per week.
projects.verification: The metric definition doc is the artefact that proves rigour.

projects.title: Full-Stack Application with Authentication and Deployment
projects.description: Ship a complete product: database, API, frontend, auth, tests and a live deployment.
objectives: Design the schema and API contract first
Build an accessible, responsive frontend
Implement secure authentication and authorisation
Write tests at both API and UI level
Deploy with a CI/CD pipeline
deliverables: Repository with README and setup guide
projects.resume_bullet_template: Built and deployed a full-stack application with <feature set> serving <users> users, with <n>% test coverage and automated deploys.
projects.verification: A live URL converts far better than a repository link alone.

projects.title: Structured Data Structures and Algorithms Practice Log
projects.description: Not a portfolio project - a disciplined study plan with a public log, aimed squarely at passing the coding screen.
objectives: Cover arrays, strings, hashing, trees, graphs, DP and heaps
Solve problems by pattern, not by memorisation
Write your own complexity analysis for each solution
Do timed mock sessions weekly
Track and revisit the problems you failed
projects.resume_bullet_template: (This one strengthens interview performance rather than the resume - keep the repository linked, not described as a project.)
projects.verification: The complexity notes are what make the repository worth linking.

projects.title: System Design Case Study Portfolio
projects.description: Write three deep design documents for systems you have not built, defending every trade-off - the closest thing to practising senior interviews on paper.
objectives: Estimate scale from first principles
Design data models and API contracts
Justify storage and caching choices
Address failure modes and bottlenecks
Present the design in 30 minutes
projects.resume_bullet_template: (Link these as writing samples rather than listing them as work experience.)
projects.verification: Be explicit that these are case studies, never presented as systems you shipped.

projects.title: Large-Scale Batch Processing with Spark
projects.description: Process a dataset too large for pandas, and learn why distributed execution behaves the way it does.
objectives: Load and transform a multi-gigabyte dataset
Understand partitioning and shuffles
Diagnose and fix a data skew problem
Cache strategically and measure the effect
Compare runtime against a single-machine baseline
deliverables: Spark UI screenshots showing the optimisation
projects.resume_bullet_template: Processed <size> of data with Spark, cutting job runtime from <before> to <after> by resolving <specific issue>.
projects.verification: The skew fix is the story. Everything else is a tutorial.

projects.title: Observability Stack for a Running Service
projects.description: Instrument a service properly with metrics, logs, traces and alerts that would actually wake someone up for the right reason.
objectives: Emit structured logs and useful metrics
Build dashboards for the four golden signals
Define alerts with thresholds you can defend
Add distributed tracing across two services
Run a game day and document what you learned
projects.resume_bullet_template: Instrumented <service> with metrics, tracing and <n> alerts, cutting mean time to detect a simulated failure to <time>.
projects.verification: The game day write-up is the artefact senior reviewers actually read.

projects.title: Model Fairness and Explainability Audit
projects.description: Take a model - yours or a public one - and audit it for bias and explainability, then document what you would change.
objectives: Measure performance across demographic or contextual slices
Apply an explainability method and interpret it critically
Identify where the training data drives the disparity
Propose and test one mitigation
Write a model card
projects.resume_bullet_template: Audited <model> across <n> slices, identifying a <gap> performance disparity and reducing it to <result> with <mitigation>.
projects.verification: State the limitations. Overclaiming on fairness work is easy to catch in interview.

projects.title: SQL Performance Optimisation Case Study
projects.description: Take slow queries on a large table and make them fast, documenting exactly why each change worked.
objectives: Generate or find a table with millions of rows
Read and interpret query execution plans
Add indexes and measure the effect
Rewrite queries to avoid scans
Document each before/after with timings
projects.resume_bullet_template: Optimised <n> reporting queries on a <size>-row dataset, reducing p95 runtime from <before> to <after> through indexing and query rewrites.
projects.verification: Execution plans are the proof. Screenshot them.

projects.title: Cloud Cost and Reliability Optimisation
projects.description: Run a small workload in the cloud for a month, then cut its cost without hurting reliability - and prove both halves.
objectives: Deploy a workload and set up cost tracking
Right-size compute and storage
Introduce autoscaling or serverless where it fits
Verify reliability did not regress
Document monthly cost before and after
projects.resume_bullet_template: Reduced monthly cloud spend for <workload> from <before> to <after> through <changes>, with no regression in p95 latency or availability.
projects.verification: Real billing screenshots (redacted) are unusually persuasive for cloud roles.
